name: agent-dispatch
description: Choose the lightest agent setup for a coding, review, drafting or design-research task: do it yourself, fan out to 2-3 workers with non-overlapping files across the Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor or other CLIs and accounts on this machine, run a scoped architecture loop, or send one brief to independent researchers; pick a cross-model reviewer, test budget and cleanup; then track dispatched work, external waits and user decisions on a Run Board the user can open any time. Use when work may need delegation, or the user asks to dispatch, fan out, parallelize, run several agents or accounts, get another AI's review or independent design opinions, or asks how dispatched work is going. Chinese triggers: 派活、并行、多开、分给多个 Claude 账号 / codex / grok、找另一个 AI 审、对比优秀设计、多方意见、进度看板、派出的任务进行到哪了。Not for unrelated read-only questions, trivial edits, research with no delegation, a single review of an existing diff (agentic-review-handoff), or the machine-wide session list (sideby sessions). If one named workflow owns the task, use this only to size workers inside it.

catalog.summary: Size a task from solo edit to parallel AI CLI worktrees, pick an independent reviewer, and step in the moment a worker finishes.
catalog.summary_zh: 评估任务该单干还是分给多个 AI CLI 并行，安排独立复审，哪个 AI 一做完就接手验收。
use_cases: Split cross-package work with non-overlapping files across 2-3 worker worktrees.
Ask several AI products the same research brief and act only on findings they agree on.
Open one board in Orca or any browser to see what each agent produced and what waits on you; it refreshes itself and keeps what you expanded.
use_cases_zh: 把互不重叠的跨包改动拆给 2 到 3 个 worktree 并行处理。
把同一份调研题目发给多个 AI 产品，只采纳多方一致的结论。
在 Orca 或浏览器里打开看板，看每个 agent 做出了什么、替你定了哪些事、哪些问题等你回答；页面自己刷新，展开的内容不会收起。

name: agent-symlink-init
description: Initialize or migrate agent-skill symlinks in any repository. Use when a project needs `.claude/skills` linked to `.agents/skills`, `AGENTS.md` linked to `CLAUDE.md`, migration away from `.ruler`-based AI rules, or removal of legacy `sync-llm-skills` copy/sync setups. Trigger on requests about Claude/Codex skill symlinks, AGENTS/CLAUDE symlinks, `.claude/skills` setup, replacing copied skill folders with symlinks, or cleaning old ruler/sync automation.

catalog.summary: Link .claude/skills to .agents/skills and AGENTS.md to CLAUDE.md while cleaning up old ruler or sync scripts.
catalog.summary_zh: 把 .claude/skills 软链到 .agents/skills，并清理旧的规则同步脚本。
use_cases: Set up .agents/skills as the single source of truth in a repository.
Migrate a project away from .ruler directories or copy-based sync-llm-skills scripts.
use_cases_zh: 在新仓库里把 .agents/skills 设为唯一技能来源并建好软链。
清理旧项目的 .ruler 目录或复制式技能同步脚本。

name: agentic-review-handoff
description: Validate pasted review findings before fixes; run same-session automatic Git review-fix-re-review with a headless Reviewer and no redundant confirmation; start fresh-eyes Git diff Review Intake; resume review-loop sessions or packets; get a DecisionConsult from another AI; or run first-principles/DDD/high-cohesion review. Requires Git and review/consult intent; ordinary implementation or commit-only requests do not start a review loop.

catalog.summary: Run an automated Git review-fix-re-review loop with a headless reviewer or consult another AI on a decision.
catalog.summary_zh: 启动带无头 Reviewer 的 Git 自动审查修复循环，或找另一个 AI 咨询决策。
use_cases: Hand your current Git diff to a headless Claude, Codex, or Grok reviewer until it passes.
Validate pasted review feedback against the codebase before applying fixes.
use_cases_zh: 改完代码后直接调无头 Claude、Codex 或 Grok 反复审改直到通过。
收到别人的评审意见后，先核对代码真伪再决定怎么修。

name: architecture-hardening-loop
description: Run a bounded scan-triage-fix-independent-review-rescan loop on an explicit or uniquely resolvable user-supplied code scope until no evidence-backed architecture fixes remain. Use for implementation-inclusive architecture cleanup, DDD or high-cohesion hardening, and autonomous architecture improvement.

catalog.summary: Scan a defined code scope, filter for real architecture harm, apply minimal fixes, and re-verify until clean.
catalog.summary_zh: 在指定代码范围内扫描、筛选真问题、最小修复并独立复核，直到没有值得修的架构项。
use_cases: Clean up module boundaries in a specific package without triggering unbounded refactors.
Triage scanner candidates with a 5-point gate so speculative abstractions get rejected.
use_cases_zh: 在明确划定的模块内做架构加固，避免无边界的全仓重构。
用五项准入条件过滤扫描器报告，筛掉过度抽象和伪问题。

name: ardot-mcp
description: This skill should be used when the user invokes /ardot-mcp or asks to package Ardot MCP through UXC, set up ardot-mcp-cli, complete Ardot OAuth for UXC, run sanitized Ardot readiness, open or inspect Ardot design files via a fixed CLI facade, or keep Grok/Claude native Ardot MCP as a compatibility path. Own Ardot endpoint identity, OAuth boundary, safe output, and task acceptance. Use uxc-facade for the generic packaging method. Do not use for one-off Ardot calls already solved by the native host MCP tools.

catalog.summary: Set up and run the ardot-mcp-cli UXC facade with OAuth binding to inspect Ardot design files from a JSON CLI.
catalog.summary_zh: 配置并调用基于 UXC 的 ardot-mcp-cli，通过固定 JSON CLI 读取 Ardot 设计稿。
use_cases: Complete Ardot OAuth and verify readiness with a single /ardot-mcp command.
Read Ardot design state across agents using a pinned UXC 0.22.0 binary.
use_cases_zh: 用 /ardot-mcp 完成 OAuth 授权并做脱敏连通性检查。
通过固定版本的 ardot-mcp-cli 读取设计稿节点与编辑器状态。

name: branch-creator
description: Create safe Git feature or hotfix branches with concise names. Use when the user asks to create a local branch or suggest a branch name. A name-only request stays read-only; an explicit creation request authorizes creation after local checks. Ordinary feature work alone does not request a branch. Do not push, commit, rebase, or create PRs.

catalog.summary: Propose or create short feat/ and hotfix/ Git branches in two shell calls using existing project terms.
catalog.summary_zh: 复用项目已有词汇，快速命名或创建简短的 feat/ 与 hotfix/ 本地 Git 分支。
use_cases: Create a 2-word feature or hotfix branch from the current HEAD without slow remote checks.
Get a branch name recommendation while keeping your working tree untouched.
use_cases_zh: 准备写新功能或修线上紧急问题前，快速切出简短的本地分支。
只想要个顺手的分支名建议，不改动当前工作区。

name: chrome-dev-mcp
description: Use this skill when the user invokes /chrome-dev-mcp or asks for Chrome DevTools MCP, CDP, list_pages/select_page, UXC packaging for Chrome DevTools, DOM snapshots, Console, Network, Performance, Lighthouse, heap analysis, browser-internal debugging, connection recovery, or correct-Chrome validation across Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build/Grok002, Cursor CLI, Hermes, or WorkBuddy. Use it when the evidence is Chrome-specific (Lighthouse, a full trace, heap data) or the caller has no page session yet; a page already open in ego-browser keeps its own Console and request diagnosis. Also use it as the verification step right after the user or this session changes a web UI or asks to accept or check a page: collect a screenshot, Console, and Network evidence before calling it done. Do not use it for ordinary navigation, form filling, scraping, or desktop UI unless browser-internal signals or UI-change acceptance are required. A passing readiness or list_pages check proves the connection only, never the change.

catalog.summary: Collect DOM snapshots, Console logs, Network requests, and traces from a shared Chrome via chrome-dev-mcp-cli.
catalog.summary_zh: 通过共享的 chrome-dev-mcp-cli 采集指定 Chrome 的 DOM 快照、日志、网络请求与性能轨迹。
use_cases: Inspect live Console errors and failed fetch requests on a local dev tab.
After a UI change, accept the page with a screenshot, Console, and Network evidence.
Share one managed Chrome DevTools session safely across multiple coding agents.
use_cases_zh: 在本地调试页面时抓取真实的 Console 报错、接口返回与 DOM 快照。
改完界面后用截图、控制台和网络请求做验收。
让多个 Agent 安全复用同一个受控 Chrome 会话做页面取证。

name: code-inspector-init
description: Set up or migrate code-inspector-plugin across modern frontend frameworks. Use when you need click-to-source IDE navigation, hotkey customization, or inspector troubleshooting.

catalog.summary: Configure or fix code-inspector-plugin across frontend bundlers so clicking a DOM element opens its source.
catalog.summary_zh: 为前端项目接入或排查 code-inspector-plugin，实现点击页面 DOM 跳转到 IDE 源码。
use_cases: Add click-to-source navigation to a Next.js, Vite, or Webpack project in dev mode.
Fix broken hotkeys or IDE jump paths when code-inspector-plugin fails to open files.
use_cases_zh: 给 Next.js、Vite 或 Webpack 开发环境配好点击元素跳源码功能。
排查快捷键没反应或点击页面跳不到 IDE 对应代码行的问题。

name: code-plugin-architecture
description: Design, review, refactor, or explain recurring extension mechanisms when adding or removing one variant requires scattered coordinated edits. Use for plugin architecture, registries, extension points, and cross-stack contract/host mappings. Assess whether a typed map, existing framework mechanism, or lifecycle-owning core is justified. Skip one plugin's internal styling or bugs, user signup, DI containers, and package registries.

catalog.summary: Design, review, or refactor extension points so adding or removing a variant stays within one clear boundary.
catalog.summary_zh: 设计、评审或重构扩展点，让增删一种业务变体不必到处散落改代码。
use_cases: Decide whether a switch statement, typed map, or lifecycle-owning core fits your variants.
Refactor scattered variant branches into a single registry and contract.
use_cases_zh: 评估当前分支逻辑该保持现状、改用类型映射表，还是抽出带生命周期的 Core。
把散落在多处的同一种扩展改动收敛到清晰的契约和注册表里。

name: commit
description: Generate read-only emoji-prefixed Conventional Commit messages or create focused local commits from staged changes or a clear user-authorized unstaged scope.

catalog.summary: Draft an emoji Conventional Commit message or create a focused local Git commit after checking for secrets.
catalog.summary_zh: 生成带 emoji 的 Conventional Commit 消息，或在检查敏感文件后创建聚焦的本地提交。
use_cases: Commit only staged or task-related files while updating .gitignore for build noise.
Generate a read-only commit message without staging or committing anything.
use_cases_zh: 把刚改完的一组相关文件做成干净的本地提交，顺手拦住未忽略的缓存或密钥文件。
只让 AI 看 diff 写一条符合规范的提交信息，不执行实际提交。

name: commit-push
description: Commit or push one focused, inspected Git change set with an emoji Conventional Commit message and verified remote delivery. Use for explicit commit-and-push requests or pushing existing local commits to non-CNB remotes; cnb.cool remotes and CNB MR delivery go to coco-commit-push-mr. Excludes PR/MR, force-push, merge, rebase, tag, release, and deploy workflows.

catalog.summary: Create a verified local commit with an emoji Conventional Commit message and push the current branch safely.
catalog.summary_zh: 在完成本地验证与远端预检后，生成规范提交并安全推送到当前分支上游。
use_cases: Run relevant checks, commit the scoped changes, and push to origin in one step.
Verify that the remote branch is no longer ahead after pushing.
use_cases_zh: 跑完必要检查后直接提交并 push 当前分支，一步完成远端交付。
遇到远端领先时自动做一次干净的 rebase 重试，并核对最终领先状态。

name: decision-first-technical-writing
description: Create, rewrite, or review internal technical design documents after decisions are settled or while proposals and open questions are explicitly labeled. Use for design docs, architecture proposals, module designs, API or schema designs, and decision records. Route unresolved named-option convergence to grilling (workflow-gate Challenge in convergence mode) and ready-spec task breakdown to writing-plans. Do not use for tutorials, marketing copy, or code-only implementation plans.

catalog.summary: Write or review technical design docs that lead with settled decisions and label open questions explicitly.
catalog.summary_zh: 撰写或审校结论先行的技术设计文档，把已定决策与待定提案明确分开。
use_cases: Draft an architecture or API design doc where reviewers see core decisions first.
Audit a draft design doc for hidden assumptions or unverified ordering guarantees.
use_cases_zh: 写模块或 API 设计文档时，让评审人第一眼看清已拍板的结论与边界。
检查现有设计文档里有没有把未确认的猜测混写成既定事实。

name: design-system
description: Run a shared multi-site design system where every product swaps only its interface accent color: analyze any website's theme colors and roles, wire a new site or plugin to the semantic tokens, and lint plugins for hard-coded colors, fallback values and unknown roles. Use when the user gives a URL and asks what its theme or palette is, asks to connect a site to the design system, add an accent theme, or check whether a plugin follows the theme contract. Skip one-off styling tweaks, logo or illustration work, and plugin-architecture refactors (code-plugin-architecture).

catalog.summary: Share one design system across sites: analyze a site's theme colors, wire sites to tokens, lint plugins for hard-coded colors.
catalog.summary_zh: 多个站点共用一套设计系统：分析任意站点的主题色，把站点接到语义 token 上，并检查插件有没有写死颜色。
use_cases: Give a URL and get its accent color, neutral tone, button contrast and selected-state pattern, each marked measured or inferred.
Add a new accent theme or connect a site, then lint its plugins for hard-coded colors, fallback values and unknown roles.
use_cases_zh: 丢一个网址，拿回它的强调色、中性色冷暖、按钮对比度和选中态做法，每项标明实测还是推断。
新增一套强调色主题或接入一个站点，再检查插件里写死的颜色、后备色和不存在的角色。

name: desktop-agent-activity
description: Use when 查 Orca/Claude Code 是否还在干活. Process+files first.

catalog.summary: Check whether a desktop coding agent like Orca or Claude Code is actively working, idle, or stopped.
catalog.summary_zh: 通过进程 CPU、文件修改时间和终端状态，判断桌面端的 Claude Code 或 Orca 是否还在干活。
use_cases: Tell if a long-running Claude Code session is still editing files or just sitting idle with MCP children.
Get a quick status table across all running agent TTYs without dumping raw command logs.
use_cases_zh: 挂着跑了很久的 Claude Code 没动静时，查清楚它是在干活还是闲着挂着。
同时开了多个终端窗口时，快速汇总每个实例的运行状态和判断依据。

name: dev-environment-roi-audit
description: Audit a local coding-agent environment with real logs and controlled ablations, then make evidence-backed keep, narrow, on-demand, or remove decisions for MCP servers, skills, instruction files, plugins, commands, hooks, and memory. Use whenever the user asks to audit or slim a Claude, Codex, Grok, Cursor, or similar development setup; find unused tools; quantify context or startup tax; or clean agent configuration by ROI. Enforces discovered paths, per-file JSONL schema probes, OUT_DIR-only artifacts, secret-safe output, and item-by-item approval before mutations.

catalog.summary: Audit your local agent setup with session logs and timing tests to decide which MCPs, skills, and hooks to keep.
catalog.summary_zh: 用真实会话日志和对照实验审计本地 Agent 环境，按投入产出比精简 MCP、技能与配置。
use_cases: Measure context token tax and startup latency across your installed MCP servers and skills.
Find unused tools or contradictory CLAUDE.md rules over a 90-day session window.
use_cases_zh: 量化每个 MCP、Skill 和 Hook 占用的常驻 Token 与启动耗时。
盘点过去 90 天从没调用过的工具或互相冲突的指令文件，逐项确认去留。

name: disk-tidy
description: Free disk space on a developer's Mac (Linux partly) when the disk is nearly full: measure where the space went across build output, package-manager caches, app data, AI agent data, old tool versions and worktrees, fan the read-only survey out to subagents, merge it into a tiered cleanup list, clean only what the user approves, and report the real gain from free space before and after. Use whenever the user says the disk or SSD is (almost) full, asks what is eating space, what can be cleaned or deleted to free space, or why free space keeps shrinking, in any language, Chinese included. Hands organizing personal files to file-tidy and removing git worktrees to worktree-tidy. Not for organizing files without a space problem, a single known cache command, system files that need sudo, iCloud or other cloud storage plans, or disks of remote servers, containers and Kubernetes nodes.

catalog.summary: Find what filled a developer Mac's disk, rank build caches, app data and old tool versions by risk, and clean only what you approve.
catalog.summary_zh: 找出开发机硬盘被什么占满，把构建缓存、应用数据和旧工具版本按风险分级，只清理你确认的部分。
use_cases: Survey .next and Turborepo caches, package-manager caches, chat apps and AI agent data in parallel, then get one tiered cleanup list.
Delete only git-ignored build output that no dev server is using, and see the real space gained instead of du estimates.
use_cases_zh: 并行盘点 .next、Turborepo 缓存、包管理器缓存、聊天应用和 AI Agent 数据，合并成一份分级清理清单。
只删除被 git 忽略、且没有 dev server 在用的构建产物，按清理前后的真实可用空间汇报效果。

name: figma-mcp
description: Use this skill for every /figma-mcp invocation, which covers two jobs. First, implement or match a UI from a Figma design URL or file key (e.g. '/figma-mcp <url> 按设计稿把这个页面做成 React', '/figma-mcp <url> 还原度要高'): hand the visual work to figma-design-to-code and follow it through to a finished screen, not stop at a metadata read or a screenshot. Second, install, authenticate, switch accounts, recover, or verify the official Figma MCP server across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Grok Build. Keep registration account-neutral and each supported host's OAuth flow authoritative. Use whoami for readiness, named-account, recovery, write, and multi-host checks; for a current-account single-host read task, including the implement/match path, let the first requested official read prove tool and auth readiness without a redundant identity call. Also use it to read, filter, or audit Figma file comments (resolved review threads, design review feedback), which the MCP cannot read, and to decide when a read may fall back to the Figma REST API with the user's token, such as on hosts outside the MCP Catalog like pi. Never copy OAuth tokens between hosts.

catalog.summary: Connect, authenticate, or recover the official Figma MCP server and fall back to REST for file comments.
catalog.summary_zh: 配置、认证或恢复官方 Figma MCP 服务，并在读取设计评审评论时按规则回退到 REST API。
use_cases: Read Figma design context on the fast path without redundant whoami calls.
Implement a screen from a Figma URL by following the design-to-code workflow.
Fetch and filter Figma file comments through the REST script when the MCP cannot read them.
use_cases_zh: 传入 Figma 链接直接读取设计上下文，省去多余的身份探测步骤。
拿着设计稿链接还原界面时，按设计转代码流程来做。
需要看设计稿里的评审评论或历史讨论时，用内置脚本通过 REST 接口拉取。

name: file-tidy
description: Organize a person's own files on macOS, Linux or Windows into one numbered Root (default ~/Files): empty Downloads and screenshot Inboxes, clear the desktop, file personal, work, finance, media, installer and sensitive files into Categories, find duplicate files, and point app save locations at the Inboxes. Use when the user asks, in any language (e.g. 整理文件/桌面/下载、去重), to tidy, sort, dedupe or file their Desktop, Downloads, home folder, documents or data drives, set default download or screenshot folders, repeat the scheme on a new computer, or undo a previous tidy. Every run is planned, verified, reversible and never deletes. Not for code repositories, cloud documents, photo-library management or disk-space analysis alone.

catalog.summary: Sort Downloads, Desktop, and personal files into a numbered ~/Files root with dry-run plans and full rollback.
catalog.summary_zh: 把下载目录、桌面和个人文件整理进带编号的 ~/Files 目录，支持预演、去重与一键回滚。
use_cases: Empty your Downloads and screenshot folders into numbered finance, work, and media categories.
Find byte-identical duplicates and move old installers to Trash without deleting anything permanently.
use_cases_zh: 清空乱糟糟的桌面、下载和截图目录，按财务、工作、媒体等编号目录归档。
找出完全重复的文件和已安装应用的安装包移入废纸篓，全程可按清单回滚。

name: goal-gate
description: Gate whether a coding-agent task benefits from a durable, verifiable contract, then draft, validate, start, continue, or close it for Codex, Grok, Claude Code, Cursor CLI, or an unknown host. Use for explicit goal or /goal requests and autonomous multi-checkpoint coding work with one checkable end state. Native Goal creation or mutation requires an explicit user or system request. Do not use for quick one-shot work, unrelated backlogs, OKRs, reminders, or token-budget-only changes.

catalog.summary: Decide if a task needs a verifiable Goal contract, then draft, activate, or close it with proof across hosts.
catalog.summary_zh: 判断任务是否适合立 Goal 契约，并按宿主生成、激活或凭证据关闭长任务。
use_cases: Turn a multi-step spec into a checkable Goal contract with explicit stop conditions.
Verify every Done item against real command or browser evidence before marking a Goal complete.
use_cases_zh: 把多步骤开发任务写成验收条件明确、带暂停边界的 /goal 提示词或契约。
在结束长任务前逐条核对命令输出或页面证据，防止没做完就提前报完成。

name: grill-autopilot
description: Run a grill-with-docs design interview where one AI asks and another AI answers on the user's behalf, researching reuse on GitHub and the web, so the user is only asked about side effects, facts only they know, or hard-to-reverse choices with weak evidence. Any pairing of Claude Code, Codex, Grok or pi accounts. Ends with a decision log, glossary updates and proposed decision records; optionally hands off to planning, a goal or an implementation loop. Use when the user wants a plan or design grilled without answering every question, says 'grill it for me', 'auto grill', 'answer the grill yourself', or asks two agents to interview and answer each other. Chinese triggers: 自动 grill、替我回答、两个 agent 一问一答、别问我、自己拷问方案。Not for grilling the user directly (use grill-with-docs) or reviewing code (use agentic-review-handoff).

catalog.summary: Have one AI grill your plan and another AI answer for you, researching reuse first, so you only see the few questions that truly need you.
catalog.summary_zh: 让一个 AI 拷问方案、另一个 AI 先查现成方案再替你回答，你只需要回答少数真正要你拍板的问题。
use_cases: Pair any two of Claude Code, Codex, Grok or pi accounts to stress-test a design and get a decision log with evidence for every choice.
Settle library and pattern choices by checking your repo, GitHub and the web before writing anything new.
use_cases_zh: 任选 Claude Code、Codex、Grok、pi 中的两个账号一问一答地拷问设计，最后拿到每条都附证据的决策日志。
选库、选模式前先查仓库、GitHub 和网上的成熟做法，能复用就不重写。

name: installed-app-feature-inventory
description: Use when listing a Mac app's real features from the install.

catalog.summary: List what an installed macOS desktop app actually supports by inspecting its local bundle, registry, and strings.
catalog.summary_zh: 直接检查本机已安装 macOS 应用的包目录、注册表与文案文件，盘点它真正支持的功能。
use_cases: Check which features or skills are shipped and enabled inside a local .app bundle on your Mac.
Compare public feature claims against the files actually installed on disk without flashing app windows.
use_cases_zh: 不弹窗打扰屏幕，直接拆看本地 .app 包里到底装了哪些命令和技能。
对比宣传文章里的功能清单，核实哪些功能在当前机器和版本上真正可用。

name: kimi-computer-use
description: Install, register, diagnose, or upgrade Kimi Computer Use (kimi-cu) MCP for Cursor CLI, Grok, WorkBuddy, Claude Code, Codex, or Hermes; fix kimi-cu tool-call errors such as 'no target app' or 'mode must be full, image, or ax'; or look at and verify a running macOS app UI through kimi-cu, such as checking whether a window matches a design. Not for general desktop automation, messaging, or purchasing, and not a replacement for a host's native Computer Use.

catalog.summary: Install, register, diagnose, or upgrade the local Kimi Computer Use (kimi-cu) MCP service on macOS.
catalog.summary_zh: 在 macOS 上安装、注册、排查或升级本地 Kimi Computer Use (kimi-cu) MCP 服务。
use_cases: Register kimi-cu across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Grok, or Hermes without breaking existing configs.
Check a running Mac screen through kimi-cu; a UI check with no tool call is not done.
Fix 'no target app' or 'mode must be full, image, or ax' errors and verify macOS permissions.
use_cases_zh: 把 kimi-cu 注册到多个 Agent 宿主配置里，并用只读命令验证连通性。
用 kimi-cu 查看正在运行的 Mac 界面；没真正调用工具就不算看过。
快速修复参数写错导致的调用报错，或核对辅助功能与录屏权限状态。

name: lingui-workflow
description: Choose and troubleshoot extract, translation-check, compile, and catalog-manifest commands in an existing Lingui project. Use for daily catalog maintenance and command semantics, not initial setup, plain text translation, or choosing an i18n library.

catalog.summary: Pick and troubleshoot extract, check, compile, and manifest commands for daily catalog maintenance in Lingui.
catalog.summary_zh: 在已接入 Lingui 的项目中选择并排查提取、检查、编译与 manifest 维护命令。
use_cases: Run the shortest command sequence after changing source copy or updating existing translations.
Debug missing translations or unset locale errors in React and Next.js App Router projects.
use_cases_zh: 改了源码文案或翻译词条后，挑最短的命令组合完成提取与编译。
排查文案没提取出来、翻译没生效或服务端组件 locale 未初始化的问题。

name: local-web-surface
description: Build or extend a persistent macOS local web surface when the request includes a stable *.localhost URL, an existing loopback daemon/gateway, login startup, or a thin .app launcher that opens or wakes a persistent local HTTP surface. Once triggered, it can add file-backed CRUD or local/public content projections without changing public publishing. Covers domain ownership, exact Host routing, explicit access/threat boundaries, safe mutations, launchd lifecycle, TDD, curl checks, and proportional browser QA. Do not use for public or remote URL launchers, public hosting, production deployment, ordinary frontend/CRUD work on an existing dev server, merely opening or interacting with an existing URL, website audits, or native apps with no local HTTP surface.

catalog.summary: Build or extend a persistent macOS *.localhost web surface with loopback routing, launchd startup, and safe CRUD.
catalog.summary_zh: 构建或扩展常驻 macOS 的 *.localhost 本地网页入口，配齐精确路由、开机自启与安全读写。
use_cases: Give a local tool a fixed *.localhost URL and a thin macOS .app opener backed by launchd.
Add ETag-protected file CRUD or local-vs-public content views without exposing private drafts.
use_cases_zh: 给自己的本地工具配一个固定 *.localhost 域名、LaunchAgent 自启和 .app 启动器。
在本地页面上安全读写 YAML/JSON 数据或预览私密文章，同时严守公开发布边界。

name: open-code-review-loop
description: Run a bounded OCR-delegation review-fix-re-review loop on a Git workspace until current evidence validates NO_FINDINGS. Use only when the user wants verified findings fixed and independently re-reviewed until clean with codex, claude-code, grok-build, or cursor-cli. Do not use for one-shot open-code-review-delegate or read-only review. A full loop request asks at most once for an unnamed Reviewer (recommending a product other than the host), then runs host mutation checks without further confirmation. Fail closed on missing ocr, reviewer mutation, skipped files, malformed output, stale evidence, or exhausted rounds.

catalog.summary: Run a bounded ocr delegate review-fix-re-review loop on Git changes until an independent reviewer confirms clean.
catalog.summary_zh: 基于 ocr delegate 运行有界的代码审查、修复与复审循环，直到独立 Reviewer 确认无问题。
use_cases: Select changed files and rules with ocr, send them to another AI product for review, and fix verified defects.
Enforce full file coverage and mutation checks so reviewers never silently edit your workspace.
use_cases_zh: 用 ocr 选定改动文件和规则，交给另一个 AI 宿主审查并自动修完经核实的问题。
强制核对文件覆盖率与只读边界，防止复审过程漏看文件或偷改工作区代码。

name: review-prompt-composer
description: Compose one repository-local, copy-ready Markdown prompt for another team or AI agent to review Git changes in the same working tree. Use for prompt-only requests covering committed ranges, staged, unstaged tracked, untracked, or all uncommitted changes when the reviewer can read the same repository and index. Persist under $repo_root/.review-handoff/prompts/ with branch-aware naming, 24-hour expiration, strict scope evidence, and a Review-Prompt-ID. Do not execute the review, run tests, modify reviewed code, commit, stage, stash, push, send the prompt, duplicate code, or use when the receiver lacks working-tree access. Use agentic-review-handoff to execute reviews, validate returned feedback, or run review-fix-re-review loops.

catalog.summary: Generate a copy-ready Markdown review prompt with scope digest and freshness checks for another agent in the repo.
catalog.summary_zh: 在仓库内生成带范围摘要与新鲜度校验的 Markdown 评审提示词，直接复制给其他 Agent 审代码。
use_cases: Create a self-contained review prompt for staged, unstaged, or branch changes without pasting raw diffs.
Let a second agent verify that the working tree has not drifted before starting its review.
use_cases_zh: 为暂存区、工作区或分支提交生成一份可直接复制给另一个窗口的审核提示词。
附带 SHA-256 范围摘要和只读校验命令，让接手的 Reviewer 先确认代码没变再开审。

name: task-completion-loop
description: Finish an existing named plan/spec or clearly bounded unfinished non-trivial coding task through the explicit task-completion-loop: work ledger, Goal, implementation proof, agentic review, architecture hardening, and a fresh Claude audit. Use only for the whole requested pipeline, not ordinary implementation, planning, or review.

catalog.summary: Drive an unfinished plan through three-party AI convergence, implementation, review, hardening, and blind audit.
catalog.summary_zh: 通过三方 AI 交叉质疑、实现验证、审查、架构加固与盲审，把半成品或方案一直推进到可验证完成。
use_cases: Take a named spec from pending items to verified completion across Claude, Codex, and Grok.
Run automated review, architecture hardening, and a fresh Claude blind audit on the final code snapshot.
use_cases_zh: 拿着现成的 plan 或半成品任务，拉起宿主与另外两个 AI 交叉质疑后再动手实现。
在交活前用同一份最终代码快照连过代码复审、架构加固和全新 Claude 盲审三道门禁。

name: uxc-facade
description: This skill should be used when the user invokes /uxc-facade or asks to package, harden, or reuse an MCP, OpenAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, or JSON-RPC interface through UXC; create or maintain a stable uxc link; reuse a daemon-backed stdio child; pin UXC for automation; or design a deterministic JSON CLI facade for another skill. Apply the facade contract without replacing service-specific identity checks. Do not use for ordinary one-off API calls, and hand Chrome DevTools-specific work to chrome-dev-mcp.

catalog.summary: Wrap an MCP, OpenAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, or JSON-RPC endpoint into a pinned UXC CLI link with daemon reuse.
catalog.summary_zh: 把 MCP、OpenAPI、GraphQL、gRPC 或 JSON-RPC 接口封装成固定版本的 UXC 命令行入口。
use_cases: Design a stable JSON CLI command and ownership contract for a shared MCP server.
Reuse an expensive stdio MCP child process across agent turns with verified daemon hits.
use_cases_zh: 把开销较大的 stdio MCP 进程封装成固定命令名，让多轮调用复用同一个后台会话。
为新的服务技能制定 UXC 二进制归属、链接校验和脱敏探活合同。

name: web-performance-audit
description: Run a read-only, evidence-led runtime performance audit of a real web application, especially authenticated editors, dashboards, media tools, long-lived SPAs, and pages with many tabs or states. Use when the user asks to profile slowness, inspect every tab, use Chrome DevTools or Chrome Recorder, run React Scan, compare normal and throttled interactions, find memory or rendering risks, or produce a performance report and recommendations without changing code. Discover available browser capabilities, guide the user through official installation when an important capability is missing, route to validated fallbacks, isolate measurement pollution, and distinguish measured facts from screen observations, hypotheses, and unverified paths. Do not use for a Lighthouse-only SEO/accessibility audit, tool installation with no audit goal, or when the user already wants a specific optimization implemented.

catalog.summary: Run a read-only runtime performance audit on a live web app with repeatable traces, controls, and a report.
catalog.summary_zh: 对真实运行中的 Web 应用做只读运行时性能审计，用对照实验与轨迹证据定位卡顿并恢复现场。
use_cases: Profile slow interactions, tab switches, or memory growth in a signed-in SPA without touching source code.
Compare normal vs 4× CPU slowdown runs and separate tool noise from verified product bottlenecks.
use_cases_zh: 在不改业务代码的前提下，对需要登录的复杂后台或编辑器做交互耗时与内存排查。
对比正常模式与 4 倍 CPU 降速下的表现，区分测量污染和真正值得修的瓶颈。

name: weekly-report
description: Generate structured weekly reports from Git commit history across one or multiple repositories. Use when you need concise, project-grouped progress summaries for status reporting.

catalog.summary: Read Git commits across one or multiple repositories and generate a project-grouped Markdown weekly report.
catalog.summary_zh: 读取单个或多个 Git 仓库的提交记录，过滤琐碎改动并按项目分组生成 Markdown 周报。
use_cases: Summarize your commits from this week or a custom date range across all local and remote branches.
Merge new commit summaries into an existing draft in ~/.weekly-reports/ while keeping manual notes.
use_cases_zh: 周五直接从多个项目的 Git 历史里拉出本周提交，自动按项目整理成周报草稿。
生成半年或自定义时间段的工作总结，自动过滤 typo 和 merge 等琐碎记录。

name: workflow-gate
description: Classify which workflow or skill should run when route choice matters: unresolved creative work, named-option decisions, explicit Goal management, destructive actions, architecture work, planning, debugging or ship checks, review handoff, and full-completion pipelines. Skip trivial one-line work and clearly matching safe named-skill requests. Treat first-principles analysis as a method, not a Challenge trigger unless the user is widening the option space.

catalog.summary: Route a coding request to the right workflow—direct work, debugging, grilling, planning, architecture, or review.
catalog.summary_zh: 在动手前快速判断当前请求该直接改、调试、追问方案、拆计划、做架构加固还是走复审。
use_cases: Catch destructive actions or unresolved product choices before an agent starts writing code.
Pick the lightest workflow skill that protects correctness without over-planning simple edits.
use_cases_zh: 在写代码前拦住不可逆的高危操作，或者把还没想清楚的功能需求先导向方案追问。
避免简单改动被过度规划，也防止复杂架构或调试任务不经排查就直接硬改。

name: worktree-tidy
description: Find and remove stale git worktrees across one or many repositories: prune records of worktrees whose folder is gone, report every linked worktree with its idle days, uncommitted changes and pull/merge request state (GitHub, cnb.cool, GitLab), and remove clean ones the user confirms (idle by default, with an explicit recent-only exception), keeping their branches unless the request is merged or closed. Use when the user asks, in any language, to clean up, list, audit or prune git worktrees, or when a sidebar such as Orca shows too many worktrees. Not for deleting branches without worktrees, cleaning build caches, or removing whole repositories.

catalog.summary: Scan repositories for idle Git worktrees, check PR/MR merge status, and remove only clean ones you confirm.
catalog.summary_zh: 扫描一个或多个仓库里闲置的 Git worktree，结合 PR/MR 状态只清理你确认过的干净目录。
use_cases: Clean up leftover agent worktrees crowding your Orca sidebar or code folders without losing uncommitted work.
Check idle days and GitHub, GitLab, or cnb.cool merge state before pruning worktrees and merged branches.
use_cases_zh: 清理并行派活或看 PR 后残留的大量 worktree，释放侧边栏和磁盘目录。
结合闲置天数、未提交改动和远端 PR/MR 合并状态，安全删掉已合并的旧工作树。
